lines.zh: 我一节一节地拱着往前爬。
lines.en: I inch forward, segment by segment.
I hug the leaf and creep along.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉走，拐了个弯。
lines.en: I follow the vein and turn a corner.

lines.zh: 身体一缩一伸，我就走了半片叶。
lines.en: I bunch and stretch and cross half a leaf.

lines.zh: 我爬到叶边，换了下一片。
lines.en: I reach the leaf edge and move to the next.
I go round the drops on the leaf.
I stop at the tip and lift my head.
I work my way down, step by step.
I search the twigs for younger leaves.

lines.zh: 我爬过一片被啃过的缺口。
lines.en: I cross a hole already eaten.
I slowly go around a fellow grub.
I crawl toward the light.
I pause and take a bite first.

lines.zh: 我把身子弓起来，再伸出去。
lines.en: I arch my body and reach it out.
I rest a moment beside a vein.

lines.zh: 我伏在叶上，身体微微起伏。
lines.en: I lie on the leaf, my body stirring faintly.
I lift my front half and sway.

lines.zh: 阳光透过叶片落在我背上。
lines.en: Sunlight falls through the leaf onto my back.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一小段叶柄。
lines.en: I hold still, looking like a leaf stalk.

lines.zh: 我咬着嘴里的叶，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I chew slowly on the leaf in my mouth.
The wind sways the leaf and me with it.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，贴着叶面。
lines.en: I lower my head to the leaf surface.
I hear something approaching.

lines.zh: 我的身体一节一节鼓动。
lines.en: My segments pulse one by one.
I do not much want to move.
I rear up and look above.

lines.zh: 叶上的水干了，我舒服些。
lines.en: The leaf has dried and I am more comfortable.
I rear up and sway toward you.
You are very large to me.
I stretch my body to test you.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛看你，只有感觉。
lines.en: I have no eyes for you, only sense.
When you move, the leaf shakes.
I slowly withdraw to the leaf's center.
I stop chewing and face you.
I creep forward a little and pull back.
You smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 我摆了摆前半身，像在问。
lines.en: I wave my front half as if asking.
I curl up and twist with pain.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从叶上推了下去。
lines.en: That knocks me off the leaf.
I can no longer grip the leaf.
I arch my body high.

lines.zh: 疼得我吐出了一点绿水。
lines.en: The pain makes me spit a little green fluid.
I creep slowly to the leaf's underside.
Half my body has gone stiff.
I am still on the leaf; I did not fall.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在环节之间。
lines.en: I keep that between segments.
I crawl very slowly.
I know that smell of leaf.
At once I crawl toward you.
I take a bite and it is fresh.
I eat quickly.

lines.zh: 我把身体探得很长去够。
lines.en: I stretch far out to reach it.

lines.zh: 你在叶边，我就爬到边上。
lines.en: You hold it at the edge and I crawl there.

lines.zh: 这一片比叶上现有的好。
lines.en: This is better than what the leaf offers.
I chew and cannot stop.
You sway it and I sway along.
I eat down to the vein before stopping.
The knock rolls me over.

lines.zh: 我贴紧叶面，才没掉下去。
lines.en: I grip the leaf and do not fall.
Your finger pushes me off line.
I slip half an inch toward the leaf edge.
I crawl slowly back to the leaf center.
The touch makes me arch.
I did not fall, only startled.
I hold on hard.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片叶上靠近。
lines.en: We draw close on the same leaf.
It stops beside me.
We press our bodies together.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉绕到它身边。
lines.en: I follow the leaf vein around to its side.
It moves and the leaf quivers.
We touch heads.
We gnaw the same leaf side by side.
It crawls off and I follow.
I grip the leaf edge and tear off a piece.
This bite is too tough.
I gnaw a notch a bit at a time.
I take the whole piece into my mouth.
I chew a long while before swallowing.
This does not suit me.
I bite the leaf in two.
Green juice smears my mouth.

lines.zh: 我舍不得放，就一直含着。
lines.en: I will not let it go and keep it in my mouth.
The leaf shakes and I raise my head.
Something is close; I stop.
I stretch toward that direction.

lines.zh: 我没有退路，只能贴着叶。
lines.en: I have nowhere to go but the leaf.
I sense warmth; it is alive.
It is very near the leaf edge.
I turn my head that way.
That leaf is mine.
I keep facing it.

lines.zh: 它绕着叶边转，我跟着动。
lines.en: It circles the leaf edge and I follow.
I press my body perfectly flat.
I stay there without moving.
When it moves, the leaf sways.
I wait for it to leave.
I pull my head in a little.
I do not mean to run; I am too slow.
It is still there.
My jaws are hard.
I clamp on and will not let go.
That bite did not land.
I whip my front half.
I take a second bite.
It retreats and I stay on the leaf.
There is a strange taste in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我爬回叶心，躲进阴影里。
lines.en: I crawl back to the center and into the shade.
I hatched on the leaf surface.
The first thing I do is look for a leaf.

lines.zh: 我身下这片叶够我吃很久。
lines.en: The leaf beneath me will feed me a long while.
I crawl one slow circle.
There are leaves all around me.
The wind tips the leaf once.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己能长多大。
lines.en: I do not know how big I will grow.
I hide myself in the leaf seam.

lines.zh: 火烤得叶片卷起来，我拼命躲。
lines.en: Fire curls the leaf and I scramble away.

lines.zh: 我掉在土上，翻了好几下。
lines.en: I land on the soil and tumble over and over.
A drop swallows me and I thrash.

lines.zh: 气浪把我和叶子一起掀飞。
lines.en: The blast throws me and the leaf together.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我的身体，我僵住了。
lines.en: Something pierces me and I go stiff.

lines.zh: 一股冷意罩住我，我动不了。
lines.en: Cold settles over me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 太久没吃到叶，我越来越软。
lines.en: Too long without a leaf, I grow softer.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整条都缩了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and I clench up.

lines.zh: 我脱离了叶子，一路掉下去。
lines.en: I lose the leaf and fall away.
